required_source.version: Averaged HBA 7T v1.0; sub-01 T2 file version 1

title: Healthy-source T2: complete sections and local observations
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Relate complete source sections to enlarged observations at the same physical point, while distinguishing acquisition, reconstruction and anatomical interpretation.

scenes.title: Complete central T2 sections
scenes.prompt: Identify the three planes and their shared cursor. Follow ventricular fluid and surrounding gray and white matter through adjacent original sections.
scenes.note: Original healthy sub-01 T2, averaged and ACPC-oriented by the source authors. The delivered 0.25 mm reconstructed grid describes output sampling; acquisition resolution is documented separately. Regional observation points support comparison of adjacent source sections. Author-provided skull stripping sets the visible coverage, including the black outer mask edge. Tissue identification and individual variation are assessed separately from these display anchors.
